usages.usage: 不可數名詞，指工作或職業這件事
表示時間比平常或理想時間晚
指前面提到的兩個選項都可以或都喜歡
用 it is hot/cold 表示天氣或環境溫度
examples: Sometimes it depends if it's 《hot》 or 《cold》.

usages.usage: 用來表示知道比較好的做法，但實際上沒有做
放在形容詞或動詞後面，表示程度或數量足夠
作副詞，修飾 sleep，表示睡眠品質好
表示使某人變成某狀態，或表示發出某種聲音
examples: because of the noise that it 《makes》.

breakdowns.sentence: Today, I will be interviewing my sister again with some new beginner English questions.
breakdowns.translation: 今天我會再次訪問我的妹妹，問一些新的初學者英文問題。

points.label: 未來進行式
points.text: will be + V-ing
points.note: 用來說明接下來節目中即將進行的活動。

breakdowns.sentence: Something I do every day is probably drinking a banana smoothie.
breakdowns.translation: 我每天會做的一件事大概是喝香蕉冰沙。

points.label: 動名詞作補語
points.text: 主詞 + be + V-ing 名詞片語
points.note: drinking a banana smoothie 說明「每天做的事」是什麼。

breakdowns.sentence: Pozole is a soup made from pork meat, puffed corn, tortilla or tostada chips, lettuce, oregano, and some spicy sauce.
breakdowns.translation: Pozole 是一種用豬肉、玉米和其他材料做成的湯。

points.label: 過去分詞片語修飾名詞
points.text: a soup + made from...
points.note: made from... 簡化了 which is made from...，用來說明湯的材料。

breakdowns.sentence: Have you ever visited another country?
breakdowns.translation: 你曾經去過其他國家嗎？

points.label: 現在完成式經驗問句
points.text: Have + 主詞 + ever + 過去分詞
points.note: 用 ever 詢問到目前為止是否有過某種經驗。

breakdowns.sentence: It's where I have not been yet.
breakdowns.translation: 那是我還沒有去過的地方。

points.label: 現在完成式搭配 yet
points.text: have not + 過去分詞 + yet
points.note: 表示到現在為止還沒有去過，但未來可能會去。

breakdowns.sentence: Now that we've gotten to know Brianna a little bit better, now we'll talk about our conversation about sleep.
breakdowns.translation: 既然我們已經更了解 Brianna 一點了，現在要談睡眠。

points.label: now that 引導原因／背景子句
points.text: Now that + 主詞 + have + 過去分詞, 主句
points.note: now that 表示「既然已經……」，用來銜接下一個話題。

breakdowns.sentence: How many hours of sleep do you normally get?
breakdowns.translation: 你通常睡幾個小時？

points.label: How many + 名詞問句
points.text: How many + hours of sleep + do + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: 用 how many 詢問可數的數量，hours 是被問的數量。

breakdowns.sentence: If I take longer naps, I feel sleepier.
breakdowns.translation: 如果我睡比較久的小睡，我會更想睡。

points.label: if 真實條件句
points.text: If + 現在式, 主詞 + 現在式
points.note: 用來描述常見或真實可能發生的情況與結果。

breakdowns.sentence: Complete darkness, I would say.
breakdowns.translation: 我會說是完全黑暗。

points.label: would say 表示委婉判斷
points.text: 主詞 + would say
points.note: would say 讓回答聽起來比較保留、比較口語。

breakdowns.sentence: My nightly routine is washing my face, brushing my teeth, doing skincare, and using my sleep mask.
breakdowns.translation: 我的夜間例行程序是洗臉、刷牙、做保養和使用睡眠眼罩。

points.label: 動名詞串列作補語
points.text: be + V-ing, V-ing, and V-ing
points.note: 多個 V-ing 並列，說明 routine 包含哪些動作。

breakdowns.sentence: I should, but I don't.
breakdowns.translation: 我應該這樣做，但我沒有。

points.label: 助動詞省略
points.text: should + 省略前文動作, but + don't
points.note: 省略重複的動詞片語，口語中更自然。

breakdowns.sentence: Do you like listening to music while trying to sleep?
breakdowns.translation: 你喜歡一邊試著睡覺一邊聽音樂嗎？

points.label: while + V-ing
points.text: while + trying to sleep
points.note: while trying to sleep 表示兩個動作同時發生。

breakdowns.sentence: Would you say you sleep well?
breakdowns.translation: 你會說你睡得好嗎？

points.label: would you say 委婉問句
points.text: Would you say + 子句
points.note: 用較委婉的方式詢問對方的看法或自我評估。

breakdowns.sentence: A recurring nightmare I have is someone in my room pulling my feet while I'm in bed.
breakdowns.translation: 我有的一個反覆惡夢是，有人在我房間裡拉我的腳。

points.label: 名詞 + 現在分詞片語
points.text: someone + pulling my feet
points.note: pulling my feet 補充描述 someone 正在做的動作。

breakdowns.sentence: I sleep with the window open when it's hot, but closed when I know I will feel cold at night.
breakdowns.translation: 天氣熱時我開窗睡，但知道晚上會冷時會關窗。

points.label: with + 受詞 + 形容詞
points.text: with + the window + open/closed
points.note: 用 open/closed 描述 window 的狀態。

breakdowns.sentence: Since my body is not used to it.
breakdowns.translation: 因為我的身體不習慣它。

points.label: since 表原因
points.text: since + 主詞 + be + 形容詞片語
points.note: since 在口語中可表示原因，意思接近 because。

breakdowns.sentence: It's just that cold rooms make me sick, and in warm rooms I can't fall asleep.
breakdowns.translation: 只是冷房間會讓我生病，而暖房間我睡不著。

points.label: It's just that + 子句
points.text: It is just that + 原因說明
points.note: 用來補充真正的原因或解釋前一句。

breakdowns.sentence: I used to sleepwalk when I was younger.
breakdowns.translation: 我小時候以前會夢遊。

points.label: used to + 原形動詞
points.text: used to + sleepwalk
points.note: 表示過去常做某事，但現在不做了。

breakdowns.sentence: I wear my warm, fluffy pajamas when I sleep so that I don't get sick.
breakdowns.translation: 我睡覺穿暖和毛茸茸的睡衣，這樣才不會生病。

points.label: so that 目的子句
points.text: so that + 主詞 + don't + 動詞
points.note: so that 表示目的，說明穿睡衣是為了不生病。

breakdowns.sentence: If I eat a lot for lunch, yes.
breakdowns.translation: 如果我午餐吃很多，會。

points.label: if 條件子句省略主句
points.text: If + 主詞 + 動詞, yes
points.note: 口語回答中省略完整主句，意思是「如果我午餐吃很多，我會累」。

breakdowns.sentence: The best way to sleep well is to not eat too much before going to sleep and not use your phone too much before going to sleep.
breakdowns.translation: 睡得好的最好方法是睡前不要吃太多，也不要太常用手機。

points.label: to 不定詞作補語
points.text: The best way + to V + is + to V
points.note: 第一個 to sleep well 修飾 way，後面的 to not eat... 說明方法內容。

breakdowns.sentence: I think it's because I either slept too much or I didn't sleep enough.
breakdowns.translation: 我覺得那是因為我要不是睡太多，就是睡不夠。

points.label: either...or...
points.text: either + A + or + B
points.note: 用 either...or... 表示兩個可能原因擇一。

breakdowns.sentence: Sometimes when I have a long day of teaching and talking to people, I feel very sleepy.
breakdowns.translation: 有時候當我教課和與人說話一整天後，我會非常想睡。

points.label: when 時間子句
points.text: when + 主詞 + 動詞, 主句
points.note: when 帶出發生情境，主句說明在那種情況下的感覺。

breakdowns.sentence: If you enjoyed my interview content, like and subscribe, and you'll probably like these next videos as well.
breakdowns.translation: 如果你喜歡我的訪問內容，請按讚並訂閱，你也可能會喜歡接下來的影片。

points.label: if 子句 + 祈使句
points.text: If + 主詞 + 動詞, 祈使動詞 + and + 主句
points.note: if 設定條件，後面用 like and subscribe 邀請觀眾行動。
